officialText:
Section 620.24(C) – Revise Informational Note No.1 in Section 620.24(C) to read as follows:

Informational Note No. 1: For additional power requirements and the current reference standard for “Safety Code for Elevators and Escalators”, see Appendix K of Chapter 30 of the New York City Building Code.
